messages:
deploy-bot: Canary post-deploy smoke finished for release/2026-03-20. Flagged: synth-embed (eu-west) queue-depth spike + p95 token latency regression. kv-probe intermittent 503s. tagging @maya @sam for triage
maya: saw the alert, pulling graphs now. is this isolated to eu-west or cross-region?
sam: looks concentrated in eu-west, but there's a small bump in us-west 5m later. queue length correlated with prefill workers scaling up at rollout time.
liam: could be backpressure from a downstream cache refilling job. any long-running prefill tasks kicked off?
jane: checked job-runner logs, there was a batch-prefill started at 3301239800 that overlapped the canary. it touched the kv cluster for ~90s.
maya: ok — two vectors: cancel/pause prefill OR pin routing away from the new variant until we confirm. we should avoid full rollback if possible.
sam: agree. can we pin traffic for the canary slice back to model-variant v12 while keeping the rest of rollout? quick pin command: 
```
redwoodctl routing pin --model embed-v12 --route canary-eu --duration 30m
```
liam: also suggest throttling synth load + reduce burst concurrency by 20% to give kv cache time to warm.
jane: prepared a one-liner to throttle the smoke runner: `smoke-runner scale --concurrency 6 --burst 10 --region eu-west`
ops-bot: metric snapshot at 3301239950: eu-west queue_depth p95=48 -> spike, kv_503_rate 0.8% -> 3.4%, host_cpu avg 72%
maya: proceed with pin + throttle. sam, can you run the pin? liam, can you apply throttle? I'll monitor /cc @jane
sam: running pin now...
sam: done — `routing.pin` succeeded, canary-eu traffic pinned to embed-v12 at 3301239987
liam: applying throttle... `smoke-runner` scaled to concurrency 6, burst 10 at 3301239995
deploy-bot: rerunning post-deploy smoke (targeted) — will post results shortly
deploy-bot: Post-action smoke: eu-west p95 token latency decreased from 2.6s -> 1.1s, queue_depth stabilized, kv_503_rate down to 0.6%. No new host OOMs reported.
maya: nice. leaving the pin for 30m as planned, then we will WEIGHT test a small increment if stable.
jane: I'll add a quick note to the release thread: pin applied due to kv-prefill overlap, follow-up to look at prefill scheduling.
sam: follow-up action: reschedule prefill jobs to avoid overlapping canaries. I can put a constraint window.
liam: I'll open a short ticket to add a canary-aware prefill guard in job-runner.
maya: thanks everyone. keeping this thread for the next 30m; if metrics stay stable, we'll unpin and proceed with staggered ramp. :thumbsup:
